copy.tagline: 用 Rube MCP 自动执行 Anonyflow 任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要重复操作 Anonyflow 任务，想用 MCP 简化流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate Anonyflow tasks with Rube MCP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly repeat Anonyflow tasks and want to streamline them via MCP

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 Anonyflow 任务。它会先搜索最新工具架构，检查连接，然后按需调用工具完成操作。
howto.when: 当你说“帮我操作 Anonyflow”或要求执行 Anonyflow 自动化任务时触发。需要 Rube MCP 已连接且 Anonyflow 连接激活。

say.note: Claude 会引导你完成授权。

say.text: 在 Anonyflow 里执行批量操作。
say.note: Claude 会先找工具再执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate Anonyflow tasks via Rube MCP. It searches for current tool schemas, checks connection status, and executes tools accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage Anonyflow tasks. Requires Rube MCP connected and Anonyflow connection active.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you through auth.

say_en.text: Run a bulk operation in Anonyflow.
